title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Survey Chart. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Survey Chart
options.lineage: hydrographic survey sheets — NOAA/BSH chart conventions
options.thesis: The generator is a survey office: every map is an issued chart — drawn in passes, keyed in the margin, corrected in magenta.
options.viewport: A chart sheet fills the viewport inside its neatline: the map plate upper-left, the title block and survey tables ruling the right margin, the Generate action stamped in magenta.
options.risk: Two-ink print discipline drifts into costume if the margins are decorated rather than working; cream paper is also where lazy vintage lands when commitment is thin.

raised.raise: The Same-Hand Rule — nothing on the sheet is a frozen exhibit; the chart you read is the instrument you act on. Probe, skip, and dial all happen on the artifact itself.

The Sounding Scale — elevation reads as a ruled, exact value scale (the grayscale pass is literally a legend of levels), and the reveal's stages run as measured, equal-ruled survey passes, never loose crossfades.
Directed Recalibration — turning a dial pours the change across the plate; input and effect connect through visible directed motion, not an instant swap.

One Vivid Event — the sheet stays ink-disciplined precisely so the colorization moment (the twelve biome hues landing) is the single optical event of the page; state changes mark themselves at edges, not by flooding.

options.label: The False-Color Survey
options.thesis: The generator is a ground-station console: biomes are false-color composites, stages are band passes, the seed is a capture ID.
options.viewport: A dark console: the composite plate centered large, orbit metadata and band controls in a right-hand telemetry column, the probe reading as a live ground-station line.
options.risk: The false-color idiom is what every space-flavored tool reaches for — distinctive only at full commitment — and it is another dark room, the very register you called bland.

options.label: The Loud Frame
options.thesis: The map is the photographed reality; a loud system of saturated bars and heavy grotesque type frames it, and the system survives every rearrangement.
options.viewport: A neutral ground, the biome map large and level, one cyan bar shouldering the title, preset actions as stacked colored blocks that snap on hover.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — the map is the photograph the system frames; holds the impact axis for design-literate visitors, loses narrowly on instrument calm.
options.risk: Bars overrunning labels fight a precision tool; the grammar needs strict containment.

options.label: The Night Session
options.lineage: green-phosphor terminals in midnight machine rooms
options.thesis: Generation is a typed session: stages print themselves as passes, the map is the session's live plot, every control is a command.
options.viewport: One dark glass sheet: the plotted map as the session's output, controls as a prompt ledger down the side, the cursor breathing between passes.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — the staged reveal is already a narrated log; holds the demoscene identification axis, loses on carrying twelve biome hues in a single phosphor.
options.risk: Monospace-everything strains sliders and legend, and it re-darkens the register you flagged as bland.

options.label: The Painted Stack
options.thesis: The generator as a shoebox of black-and-white cards linked by painted buttons.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a one-bit world cannot carry the twelve-hue biome palette that is the product's own data.
options.kept: The Same-Hand Rule — the surface you read is the surface you act on.

options.label: The Measured Score
options.thesis: Terrain as a vertical staff read upward, shape as direction, shading as level.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a vertical staff reads time, not terrain, and this audience does not read dance notation.
options.kept: The Sounding Scale — shading encodes level exactly and durations are exact.

options.label: The Gravity Garden
options.thesis: A surreal garden where rain falls toward whatever each cloud decrees.
options.case: Fuses poorly: its physics is gravity play, not terrain survey; identification collapses for both audiences.
options.kept: Directed Recalibration — cause and effect connect through visible flowing motion.

options.label: The Spectral Edge
options.thesis: A plain white cloud that grows one narrow crown of mint, rose, and violet.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a pastel fringe cannot carry instrument legibility or twelve biomes.
options.kept: One Vivid Event — a disciplined plain ground that lets a single optical phenomenon own the attention.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark app shell every map generator ships: clean grid, sliders in a card, one accent, a shadowed canvas.
canonCard.viewport: Map card left, control card right, everything quiet so the map reads.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other generator by design.
